# cmd/constitution-lint/secret-patterns.txt
# One RE2 regular expression per line (Go regexp/syntax). # comments and
# blank lines are ignored. Well-known, low-false-positive secret SHAPES
# only — this is a mechanical prefix/shape scanner, not an entropy
# analyzer, per the H8 handoff plan's "mechanical" framing.

# AWS access key ID
AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}

# PEM private key header (RSA / EC / OpenSSH / generic)
-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----

# Anthropic API key
sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}

# OpenAI-style API key
sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}

# GitHub personal access token
ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}

# Slack token
xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}
